{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the status column
print("Unique values in 'status':", df['status'].unique())

# Check the revenue column dtype and sample
print("Revenue dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample of revenue:", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for missing age sentinel
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age = -1: {len(missing_age)}")

# Check for any other anomalies
print("Number of rows with revenue == '0.00':", (df['revenue'] == '0.00').sum())"}
